operations.summary: Resolve a CVDR regulation to its version on a specific date
operations.description: Returns the version in force on the given date, plus its consolidated PDF, bijlagen, neighbour version labels, a work-level withdrawn flag, and the full version list. Use this instead of /versions when you want a single version, not the whole history.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) to resolve against. Required.

CvdrAtResponse.description: Version-resolved-by-date envelope for a CVDR regulation

date.description: Date the response was resolved for (ISO YYYY-MM-DD)

version.description: The version in force on date; null when no version covers it

pdf.description: Consolidated PDF of the resolved version; null when none

bijlagen.description: Bijlage (annex) PDF attachments of the resolved version

previousVersion.description: version label of the temporally-preceding version; null at the start of coverage

nextVersion.description: version label of the temporally-following version; null at the end of coverage

withdrawn.description: True when the work was withdrawn (datumIntrekking) on or before date

versions.description: Full version list (latest → oldest by validFrom)

CvdrVersionItem.description: A single version (toestand) of a CVDR regulation

version.description: Manifest expression label - pass as the ?version= parameter on /text, /toc, /parts

validTo.description: Version valid to date (null if open-ended)

validFromEstimated.description: True when validFrom was derived/estimated rather than declared verbatim

url.description: Canonical portal URL for this toestand (display only)

textUrl.description: cdx-nl:// URL to fetch this version's text

pdf.description: Rendered consolidated PDF for this toestand; null when none

bijlagen.description: Bijlage (annex) PDF attachments for this toestand

CvdrAttachmentRef.description: Reference to a CVDR attachment (consolidated PDF or bijlage)
